hero.description: Civic problems don't stay broken because nobody saw them. They stay broken because nobody is accountable. CivicLedger enforces SLA timers, AI-verified closures, and an immutable hash-chained log.

problem.title: Why civic repairs fail today
problem.subtitle: Without verifiable evidence and public timers, complaints fall through the cracks.
problem.card1Desc: Official MoRTH records show over 1.68 lakh lives lost in a single year, highlighting severe infrastructure risks on public roads.
problem.card2Desc: Pothole fatalities climbed from 1,481 in 2021 to 1,856 in 2022 (reported from MoRTH data by national press), showing worsening road hazards.
problem.card3Desc: Complaints routinely get closed on paper without photographic proof or location verification, leaving hazardous defects unresolved.
problem.sources: Sources: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) Road Accidents in India 2022 report & official press analysis.

approach.title: A 6-step chain of accountability
approach.subtitle: From citizen camera to tamper-evident public record.
approach.step1Desc: Citizen captures a live photo on site with automatic GPS verification.
approach.step2Desc: Computer vision detects defect type, calculates area ratio, and scores severity.
approach.step3Desc: Matched instantly to ward asset, responsible department, and active contractor.
approach.step4Desc: Public acknowledgement and resolution countdown timers start ticking.
approach.step5Desc: Overdue tickets escalate automatically through 3 administrative tiers.
approach.step6Desc: Proof-of-repair is checked by AI before closure and permanently anchored in the ledger.

pillars.title: Built on three core pillars
pillars.p1Desc: Computer vision models automatically analyze citizen photos, classify issues like potholes or garbage dumps, and assign priority severity scores.
pillars.p2Desc: Every task assigned to a contractor or municipal department triggers a public countdown. Silence triggers automatic escalation to senior officials.
pillars.p3Desc: Field workers must submit live "after" evidence. AI checks GPS coordinates, scene geometry, and defect re-presence before allowing case disposal.

features.title: Key capabilities in this prototype
features.subtitle: Explore 8 integrated modules built for citizens and municipal officers.
features.f1Desc: Camera-only submission prevents photo reuse, verifies live capture, and geotags location.
features.f2Desc: Fast, passwordless citizen authentication via one-tap simulated SMS verification.
features.f3Desc: Complete bilingual UI in simple, grade-6 everyday language for universal comprehension.
features.f4Desc: Citizens can speak defect descriptions aloud using integrated voice recognition.
features.f5Desc: Every case gets a unique scannable QR code and an unalterable chronological timeline.
features.f6Desc: Configurable L1, L2, L3 countdown timers automatically escalate unresolved defects.
features.f7Desc: Strict validation checks 25m GPS radius, image hash uniqueness, and AI defect absence.
features.f8Desc: Cryptographic SHA-256 chain of custody with real-time hash verification and tamper testing.

builtForEveryone.title: Built for everyone
builtForEveryone.subtitle: Designed from the ground up for citizens of all ages and abilities.
builtForEveryone.item1Desc: Instant report access without passwords, accounts, or friction.
builtForEveryone.item2Desc: Large tap targets with distinct icons and high visibility.
builtForEveryone.item3Desc: One-click toggle between languages anywhere on the page.
builtForEveryone.item4Desc: Speak directly instead of typing out descriptions.
builtForEveryone.item5Desc: Instant A, A+, and A++ text enlargement without breaking layouts.
builtForEveryone.item6Desc: High contrast ratio for clear reading under direct sunlight.

howTo.title: How to explore this demo
howTo.step1Desc: Click Launch Prototype to run the services, load simulated ward cases, and verify ledger integrity.
howTo.step2Desc: Browse the interactive ward map, inspect department scorecards, and watch the live block stream.
howTo.step3Desc: File a simulated defect with AI detection, watch SLA timers, or test tamper detection alerts.

cta.title: Ready to inspect civic accountability?
cta.subtitle: Launch the prototype now to test transparent timers, AI verification, and the tamper-evident ledger.
